compatibility.rule: Readers must reject unknown major versions and require matching ontology/class-vocabulary hashes; no implicit class-ID migration is performed

coordinate_contract.source: pinned Pizzaïolo [x, y, width, height] integer boundingRect output
coordinate_contract.wire: original-image pixel xyxy; x2=x+width and y2=y+height; finite pixel-edge extents, no normalization or resize

sample_id_policy: original pinned-generator ref, stable within the dataset version

source.image_label_inference: audited fourth_attempt infer_pizzaiolo_label predicates; 32 overlapping image-level classes
source.preparation_commit_reachability: preparation_commit is retained as the original runtime HEAD record; it is not reachable from published refs. Use preparation_source_reference_commit to fetch the code-equivalent preparation source.
source.preparation_source_reference_role: reachable code-equivalent reference, not the runtime HEAD recorded in preparation_commit; src/, tests/, pyproject.toml, and README.md trees match the historical commit exactly
source.raw_master_canonicalization: hasTopping set values sorted lexicographically; source ordering is nondeterministic and semantically unordered

split_policy.name: generator-type-stratified two-stage seeded split, adapted from fourth_attempt

supervision_contract.country_flags: Four detector categories are OWL individuals; targets are Country and its class ancestors, never the individual names as classes
supervision_contract.encoding: ontology_targets and ontology_known_mask are integer 0/1 vectors with one entry for every OWL class
supervision_contract.fixed_positive: DomainThing is positive for all generated pizza and component entities and is not trainable
supervision_contract.known_negative: Validated complete pinned-generator ingredient, base, origin, and entity-type facts use a closed-world mask for the 61 supported ontology classes only
supervision_contract.unknown: Five value-partition/spiciness classes lacking point supervision have target 0 and known mask 0; malformed metadata is rejected, never converted to negative

wire_format: UTF-8 JSON Lines (one JSON object per sample)
